name: Hermès CDR (CAD Hedged)
summary: Hermes International SCA makes, sells and distributes goods including leather goods and saddlery, ready-to-wear clothing, footwear, jewelry, perfumes and watches, as well as silk, textiles, belts, gloves, hats, furniture, wallpaper, interior fabrics and tableware. Its geographic segments are France, Europe, Japan, Asia Pacific, Americas and Others. It was founded by Thierry Hermes in 1938 and has its head office in Paris, France.
